paper_metadata.title: Simultaneously enhancing strength and ductility in near-α TA18 titanium alloy via heterogeneous lamellar structure with deformation twins

evidence.quote: Achieving excellent strength-ductility synergy in near-α TA18 Ti alloy by rolling deformation remains a huge challenge.

In summary, a TA18 Ti alloy that integrates HL structure and high-density DTs has been fabricated by using a novel technique of hot rolling at the temperature of (α + β) two-phase region and subsequent cryogenic-temperature rolling treatment

The initial TA18 Ti plate, with the dimension of 120 × 200 × 300 mm, was fabricated by melting in a plasma arc cold hearth furnace at temperatures above 1933 K (a temperature above the β phase transition point), and it exhibits the typical microstructure characteristics of as-casted near-α Ti alloys, i.e., various acicular α phases with different directions are distributed into the coarse β grains.

other.passes: two multi-pass rolling: first 120→20 mm in 12 passes; second to 5.8 mm

evidence.quote: Then the TA18 Ti plate was hot-rolled at the (α + β) two-phase region temperature of 1253 K to obtain a HL structure with CG and FG layer. Hot rolling is carried out in two multi-pass rolling processes, the first of which rolls the sheet from 120 mm to 20 mm in 12 passes, the second of which reduces the thickness to 5.8 mm, and each of which is heated and held for 90–120 min before rolling.

parameters.deformation: thickness 5.8 mm to 2.9 mm, 50% total thickness reduction

other.soaking: immersed in liquid nitrogen 30 min before each roll

evidence.quote: Then the CTR was performed at 77 K, reducing the thickness from 5.8 mm to 2.9 mm with a total thickness reduction of 50 %, resulting in TA18 with an HL structure and DT (denoted as HL + DT-TA18). To ensure that the rolling process takes place at 77 K, the titanium plates are immersed in liquid nitrogen for 30 min prior to each roll.

For comparison, the hot-rolling at β phase region and room-temperature rolling with a 50 % total thickness reduction was also performed to obtain the TA18 Ti plate with homogeneous structure (denoted as HS-TA18).

mechanisms.material_state: hot-rolled in α+β two-phase region, cryogenic-temperature rolled

evidence.quote: The high yield strength is mainly caused by the pronounce fine grain strengthening from dislocation movement obstruction at the interface between α-Ti and β-Ti lamellae in the FG regions.

mechanisms.material_state: hot-rolled in α+β two-phase region, cryogenic-temperature rolled

evidence.quote: This indicates that the non-uniformity in grain size and deformation twin distribution of the (HL + DT)-TA18 Ti alloy helps it achieve an excellent HDI strengthening effect.
